facebookresearch_metaseq/third_party/cli.load_CLIP_model: load a CLIP model by name like ViT-B/32 onto cuda or cpu device

facebookresearch_metaseq/third_party/cli.apply_bpe_merging: run the SimpleTokenizer bpe method to apply byte pair encoding merges on a single token
facebookresearch_metaseq/third_party/cli.clean_text_with_basic_clean: use basic_clean function to fix text encoding issues and unescape HTML entities
